display.title: Torah, Avodah and Gemilus Chasadim: A Healthy Diet for the Soul
display.summary_short: The world stands on three things: learning Torah, davening to Hashem and acts of kindness, especially daily tzedakah. Uncle Yossi calls them Hashem's diet for a healthy neshamah.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, recorded in the summer. Uncle Yossi teaches that the world stands on three things. Torah is our lifeline and the source of our existence, so we must set aside time to learn every day. Avodah is davening: as the Rambam taught, whatever we need, the only One to turn to is Hashem, who creates and sustains the world every second, so we pray every day with confidence that He hears us. Gemilus Chasadim, acts of kindness, includes everything between us and Hashem and between us and other people, and above all the mitzvah of tzedakah. Giving tzedakah every day helps those in need and also changes the giver, who becomes more refined with every good deed. Torah, Avodah and Gemilus Chasadim are Hashem's prescribed diet for a strong, healthy neshamah, and a blessing for a successful summer vacation.
display.lesson: Learn Torah, daven and give tzedakah every day: that is the diet that keeps the neshamah healthy.
